name: Codex hook deterministic guardrail boundary
decision: KRN may use Codex hooks for deterministic lifecycle guardrails around tool use, compaction, evidence reminders, and trust-boundary checks, but hooks must not become semantic source truth, review-gate authority, memory-promotion authority, or complete enforcement boundaries.
falsifier: A future KRN hook is treated as full enforcement, memory/source truth, or review-gate authority, or a hook decision ignores trust review, concurrent matching, event scope, or unsupported handler limits.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove hooks are configured, hooks are sufficient security boundaries, Codex will always run the intended hook, or KRN is product-ready.
